data.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Hanna (AT3), advisory 30/1450Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA BECOMES A REMNANT LOW PRESSURE AREA. As of 3:00 PM GMT Wed Sep 30 the center of Hanna was located near 33.4, -43.6 with movement E at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1008 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Nineteen-E (EP4), advisory 30/2032Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: DEPRESSION FORECAST TO BECOME A REMNANT LOW TOMORROW. As of 2:00 PM PDT Wed Sep 30 the center of Nineteen-E was located near 14.9, -127.0 with movement E at 14 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1005 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 30 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Rachel (EP3), advisory 30/2042Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL CONTINUES MOVING NORTHWESTWARD. ...NOAA HURRICANE HUNTER AIRCRAFT DATA INDICATES THE STORM IS GETTING BETTER ORGANIZED... As of 2:00 PM MST Wed Sep 30 the center of Rachel was located near 18.8, -108.0 with movement NW at 8 mph. The minimum central pressure was 978 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 85 mph.
